name: Compressarr AV1 (NVENC) v1
description: AV1 10-bit on an NVIDIA GPU (NVENC): about the quality of HEVC NVENC (fast) in 7 to 20 percent less space, at GPU speed. Needs an RTX 40-series or newer GPU and an ffmpeg build with NVENC. Keeps every English audio track untouched when it can be copied. Dolby Vision and HDR10+ files are refused (ffmpeg would drop that metadata); use a HandBrake lane for those.
